Rubén Castillo
Master Electrician | Electrical Superintendent
San Antonio, Texas | ruben.castillo@example.com | (210) 555-0108
Texas Master Electrician license (TDLR), active since 2012. OSHA 30. Bilingual English/Spanish.

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Twenty years in the electrical trade, the last ten running jobs as foreman and superintendent on commercial, school and hospital projects up to $14M electrical value. I hire, schedule and keep crews safe, and I can talk to an owner, an inspector and an apprentice on the same morning.

EXPERIENCE
Electrical Superintendent - Alamo Power & Light Contractors, San Antonio, TX | 2018 - Present
- Run 3-5 concurrent projects and 60+ electricians; schedules, manpower, RFIs and change orders.
- Delivered a 4-story medical office building and two school campuses with zero lost-time incidents.

General Foreman - Mission Electric Co., San Antonio, TX | 2012 - 2018
- Hospital and university work; coordinated with mechanical and fire alarm trades.

Journeyman Electrician - Mission Electric Co., San Antonio, TX | 2009 - 2012
